title: Killbrick's Textures
description: Killbrick's textures tries to blend the style from caelesti and a cartoonish colorful style
body: The game’s textures, but completely reimagined in my own artistic style—each one rebuilt from the ground up with unique colors, stylized shapes, custom shading, and a personalized visual aesthetic that transforms the entire world into something fresh, distinctive, and unmistakably mine.
